summary: A mixed day spanning significant legal rulings on regulatory overreach, food safety compliance challenges for the retail sector, and major capital market developments including the Jio Platforms IPO approval.

bullets.text: Bombay High Court rebukes FDA for 'high-handed' cancellation of Cipla drug licences without proper procedure.
Nestle urges India to consult industry while drafting front-of-pack food warning label regulations scientifically.
India's markets regulator approves Jio Platforms' $3.8 billion IPO, major step for Reliance subsidiary.
Blackstone seeks to sell up to 25% stake in India's Knowledge REIT for over $1 billion.
Food safety body urges focus on compliance fixes as restaurants face hygiene violation allegations.
